text:
maria-ml: Observed a p95 spike on route /chat/stream after last night's rollout of dynamic token budgets. p95 went 220ms -> 490ms for standard tier. Anyone else seeing this?

jon-engineer: Yup, saw alerts. Looks correlated with the new token budget calc: we now allow up to 1024 tokens aggregate per batch for standard routes. Might be increasing batching latency.

ashok-runtime: Quick dump of profiler around the window — more kernel fallbacks and KV cache misses.

katie-sre: @ashok-runtime can you paste the logs/quant?

ashok-runtime: 
```
window 2026-03-16T02:10Z
route=/chat/stream tier=standard p95=490ms tokens_per_batch=832 avg_batch_sz=6
kernel=fallback_fp32 reason=quant_unavailable
kvcache_misses=0.23
queue_time_p95=290ms
```

maria-ml: Interesting — queue_time is primary. Could be queue policy causing large slow batches. Current policy: priority by tier then FIFO. dynamic token budget uses median token length * multiplier.

jon-engineer: Proposed quick mitigation: enforce per-request token budget cap of 256 for standard, 1024 for premium; and switch queue policy to rate-aware (token-weighted) for 2hrs to validate.

ci-bot: deploy started: rollout=dynamic-token-budgets-v3 -> nodeset=runtime-prod-3 (canary 5%) :rocket:

katie-sre: If we flip queue policy, ensure we monitor p95 per route and kernel fallback rate. PromQL to watch: 
```
p50_over_time(p95_latency{route="/chat/stream"}[5m])
rate(kernel_fallback_total[5m])
```

maria-ml: Agree. Also add KV cache hitratio by prefix length. If batching groups different prefixes we lose cache locality.

ashok-runtime: I'll instrument a short-sampled trace that tags batch by leading prefix hash and token budget. Will post traces shortly.

jon-engineer: Plan: 1) rollback token-budget multiplier from 3.5->2.0 for standard, 2) enable token-weighted queue policy on canary, 3) collect 2 hours data, 4) compare p95 and kernel fallback.

maria-ml: SGTM. Add an alert that triggers if p95 > 350ms for >5min on any route after changes.

katie-sre: I'll own the alert and runbook. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to canary nodeset, 5% traffic. :white_check_mark:

jon-engineer: Thanks — will follow up with perf numbers in thread.
